features: four local_gain_mean_31 values, own-plane independent-q95 candidate on noisy observation only; no subtraction of flat-control gains, no shape/amplitude/ISO/truth as predictors; underlying noise calibration still oracle D; local scope fixed central31x31,global scope complete padded304x304
rules: Stump:at most two constant-model leaves. Intervals:at most three ordered intervals on ONE feature,retain stump/constant unless training loss improves >1e-12. Min14 training states per leaf; thresholds solely training feature midpoints, leaf models learned from training risks; minimize mean per-state local-MSE/baseline ratio. Leave-one-pair-out, no source hash overlap; all states of each pair remain together. Prediction reads only features. Truth used for training and heldout evaluation, not heldout prediction.
limitations: Four reused pairs, one per ISO, already explored for model design: cross-pair check not independent final validation; features are aggregated over known centered synthetic patches, not a demonstrated localization detector. Oracle D calibration, no blind-estimation claim. No production selector, no interpolation or pixelwise fusion. Equal-state normalized risk, not pooled MSE or perceptual improvement.
